answer: Sybil farms can be resisted with surprise cross-examination. Each epoch the network randomly picks identities and asks follow-up questions about their earlier answer, such as defending a claim from the mesa of ideas they described. Replies are due within minutes and must stay consistent. A single model running a garden of hundreds of fake accounts must pay inference for every audit and fails the ledge of the deadline, so failed audits forfeit rewards and cost scales linearly with identities.
